item: Speaker cable, round-sheathed (H05VV-F): 2 x 2.5 mm2 for the woofer, 2 x 1.5 for the mid, 2 x 1.0 for the tweeter
note: Round, about 9.0, 8.0 and 6.4 across, so the gland's seal grips it (zip cord will not seal). Runs and lengths: drawings sheet 4 and 8. The cabinet's tweeter cable is fed down its channel from the bay and ends in the connector's socket standing on the bay's floor, 77 mm past the top panel's underside (40 on the bookshelf). Hypex's harness pairs are cut to about 150 mm inside the amplifier's box and butt-spliced to these: only round cable passes the glands.

item: Tweeter lead: 2 x 0.75 mm2 silicone-insulated flexible wire, twisted
note: Soldered to the tweeter's tabs, 310 mm long (220 on the bookshelf), the connector's plug on its end: it reaches the socket in the bay with the insert held clear of its pocket, and its spare loops into the bay when the insert is home (drawings sheet 3).

item: Connector, Molex Mini-Fit Jr., 2 circuits: receptacle housing 39-01-2020 with female terminals 39-00-0077 (16 AWG, the cabinet's 1.0 mm2 lead); plug housing 39-01-2021 with male terminals 39-00-0041 (18 to 24 AWG, the tweeter's 0.75 mm2 lead)
note: The tweeter's lead plugs into the cabinet's lead in the connector bay behind the insert, so the insert comes out with the tweeter (drawings sheet 3). Female contacts on the amplifier's side; pin 1 red +; mated 24 mm or less. Check the terminals' wire range against the Molex drawings and crimp with the matching tool.

item: Neutral-cure silicone sealant (a small tube)
note: Seals the tweeter cable in its channel, 20 mm deep from the bay (sheet 3), and holds the trim rings on three dots each.

item: Cable glands, M16 x 1.5, long thread (15 mm), nylon, one per cable, clamping about 4.5 to 10 mm, each with a lock nut 20 AF or less (23 across corners), 5 thick
note: One gland per cable: the 9.0, 8.0 and 6.4 mm round cables would not seal in one multi-hole insert. In ø16.5 holes on 35 mm centres in the amplifier box's lid. Each lock nut is epoxied into its ø24 x 8 counterbore under the lid before the lid goes in (glue-up G2): sunk 3 deep, no spanner reaches it. Check the clamping range against the cable you buy.

item: Adhesive cable-tie mounts, 20 x 20 mm, and 2.5 mm ties
note: Hold each run to the back panel's inner face every 150 mm, so no cable rattles against the cabinet or touches a cone.

item: Neodymium disc magnets N42: 12 x 4 mm (floorstander), 8 x 3 mm (bookshelf)
note: Four in the insert's back and four facing them in the pocket's back wall, opposite poles out; epoxy.

item: Steel dowel pins: 6 x 10 mm (floorstander), 4 x 8 mm (bookshelf)
note: Two in the insert's back locate it in the pocket: bonded with epoxy in the insert (0.1 over), a slip fit in the pocket's wall (0.2 over).

item: Tweeter fixings: floorstander, 3 x 3.0 x 12 thread-forming screws for plastics (WN 1411 / PT K30, pan head) for the retaining sleeve; bookshelf, 3 x M2.5 x 8 button heads (ISO 7380, A2) into M2.5 x 4 knurled brass inserts bonded with epoxy
note: Floorstander: into ø2.4 x 10 pilots on ø79.6 in the boss's back face. Bookshelf: inserts in ø3.6 x 5 holes on ø54 in the seat; heat-set inserts will not melt into cured resin. Measure the tweeters first (sheet 3).

item: Gaskets: 0.5 mm closed-cell foam (tweeter); 1.5 mm closed-cell foam strip, 1.0 compressed (woofer and mid flanges)
note: The tweeter's under its flange at the throat's seat; the drivers' under their flanges in the rebates, which allow 1.0 for it.

item: Driver fixings: M4 x 20 low-profile (wafer) button heads, A2, head 1.6 or less high and 8 or less across; M4 T-nuts, flange 15 or less across (woofer) and 12 or less (mid; bookshelf woofer), barrel 8 / 6 / 7 or less
note: ISO 7380 button heads are 2.2 high: too tall for the trim ring's 2 mm channel. The T-nuts' flanges must stay off the cut-outs (sheet 8, F1).

item: Baltic birch plywood 18 mm, 5 x 5 ft sheet (B/BB)
note: Nesting: fab/out/dxf/sheets.svg (floorstander); the bookshelf's panels fit one sheet. Measure the real thickness before CNC work.

item: CNC cutting of the panels (2D profiles and pockets)
source: local CNC cabinet or sign shop, makerspace ShopBot
note: Layers in each DXF name the operation. No instant online service cuts 18 mm plywood.

item: Gable, route A: laminated birch block, CNC-milled from the front for the insert's pocket
source: local CNC millwork or pattern shop
note: fab/out/step/gable-block.step. The pocket is a prism along y, so it mills from the front face with the block on its back.

item: Gable, route B: printed in pieces for a 218 x 123 x 220 resin printer (six for the floorstander, four for the bookshelf), SLA resin, filled and painted
note: stl/gable-print/: every piece 120 or less on one side, keyed at each joint by two 4 x 20 steel pins in 4.2 holes and bonded with epoxy. Hollow to 3 mm walls with drain holes in the slicer.

item: Wood glue (Titebond II or III), 10 mm fluted dowels x 28 mm for the gable
note: The holes are 10 deep in the top panel and 20 in the block. A printed gable goes on with the epoxy below instead, its base scuffed: wood glue does not hold cured resin.

item: Waveguide insert: SLA tough (ABS-like) resin or MJF nylon, one piece from a service; or halves on a desktop resin printer
note: Not MDF: the floorstander's sleeve screws thread into 2 mm walls of it. One piece needs a build of 290 x 220 x 130 or more (floorstander); halves fit a 218 x 123 x 220 printer only tilted, joined by two 3 x 16 pins and epoxy.

item: Driver trim rings, PETG or ASA, sprayed satin black
note: stl/trim-ring-*.stl: outside the rebate - 1.6, inside the surround at its glue line + 2 (PLACEHOLDER: measure the drivers and print last), a channel 10 x 2 in the back over the screw heads; held by three dots of neutral-cure silicone. The floorstander woofer's ring is 314 across: a 320 mm bed or a print service.

item: Port: tube with flange and flare collar, PETG or ASA
note: stl/port-tube-with-flange.stl is printed 10 mm long: push in dry, collar on from inside, measure the impedance dip, trim the inner end to 32 Hz, then bond (fab/README.md step 9).

item: Acoustic damping: polyester fibre fill; 10 mm wool or polyester felt; spray adhesive
for a pair: about 300 g fill and 0.5 m2 felt (floorstander), 120 g fill (bookshelf)
note: Line the floorstander's mid chamber with the felt before its top panel goes in (glue-up G5: the divider, the shelf, the sides between them, the top's underside). Fill the woofer chamber lightly, about 150 g a speaker (60 g in the bookshelf), kept a port's diameter from the port's inner end and off the amplifier's box.
